name: CCH Holdings Ltd
summary: CCH Holdings Ltd. actively participates in the dining sector, overseeing a network of chain restaurants throughout Taiwan and Japan. In addition to its culinary establishments, the company manufactures convenience meals and distributes a variety of food and beverage products. Its extensive collection of restaurant brands includes names such as Sanshang Qiaofu, Napoli, Tonkatsu, Don Mono, Pin Chuan Lan, BANCO, 33 Fried Chicken, and Tiger Dumplings.
